name: com.intoperson.auction/court-auction
title: Korea Court Auction (법원 경매 예상 낙찰가)
description: Korean court auction homes: search items, predicted winning bid, sale stats, similar sold cases.

tools.name: get_analysis_report
tools.description: Read a person's own words about court-auction items they want (region, kind, price, risk) and answer with the matching items, what was read, what was not read, and a link to the list page. Use this when: someone describes in words which auction items they are looking for, as the first call. Without a subscription, predicted price, band, chance and risk are locked. 구독 없이도 쓸 수 있으나 예상 낙찰가·위험 신호는 구독해야 열립니다.

question.description: 찾고 싶은 물건을 말로. 예: 강남구 아파트 5억 이하 유치권 없는

tools.name: search_items
tools.description: List upcoming court-auction items by words or conditions, sorted by sale day, chance or discount. Use this when: someone wants a list of items to browse or page through. 구독 없이는 사건번호·법원·종류·지역·매각일·감정가·최저가·유찰·링크만, 예상 낙찰가·범위·낙찰 가능성·위험 신호는 구독해야 열립니다.

question.description: 찾고 싶은 물건을 말로. 예: 강남구 아파트 5억 이하 유치권 없는

conditions.description: 조건 객체(목록 화면 주소의 조건과 같은 모양). question과 함께 주면 합쳐서 읽습니다.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Every field of one item with Korean labels, risk flags, court photo and report links. Use this when: the person picked one item (by id or case number). Without a subscription, predicted price, band, chance and risk show as locked.

tools.name: check_items
tools.description: For up to 20 items, say per condition whether it is met, not met or unknown (unknown when the needed case or building information was not read). Use this when: the person has a short list and wants each item checked against conditions. Without a subscription, conditions on sale chance or risk signals answer locked.

question.description: 찾고 싶은 물건을 말로. 예: 강남구 아파트 5억 이하 유치권 없는

conditions.description: 조건 객체(목록 화면 주소의 조건과 같은 모양). question과 함께 주면 합쳐서 읽습니다.

tools.name: bid_scenarios
tools.description: For one item, show where bid amounts sit in the predicted 10-90% price band (an estimate), the deposit and the gap to the predicted price. No tax numbers. Use this when: the person is deciding how much to bid. 구독자 전용.

bids.description: 원 단위 입찰가, 없으면 최저가부터 상단까지 6단계

tools.name: relax_conditions
tools.description: Count the items that match now and list the smallest changes that bring more items. Use this when: too few or no items match.

question.description: 찾고 싶은 물건을 말로. 예: 강남구 아파트 5억 이하 유치권 없는

conditions.description: 조건 객체(목록 화면 주소의 조건과 같은 모양). question과 함께 주면 합쳐서 읽습니다.

tools.name: manage_interest
tools.description: List, add or remove the subscriber's saved interest conditions (the ones behind the mail alerts). Use this when: the person wants to save, see or delete what they follow. 구독자 전용.

question.description: 찾고 싶은 물건을 말로. 예: 강남구 아파트 5억 이하 유치권 없는

conditions.description: 조건 객체(목록 화면 주소의 조건과 같은 모양). question과 함께 주면 합쳐서 읽습니다.

tools.name: get_auction_stats
tools.description: Court-auction sale statistics from the court's sale results (residential, no shares): how many sold, the median and 10-90% range of sale price ÷ appraisal and the median number of failed rounds, for a 시·군·구, its 시·도 and the whole country (or every 시·도 when no place is given). Use this when: the person asks what share of the appraisal items usually sell for in a place. 누구나 쓸 수 있습니다.

question.description: 지역·종류를 말로. 예: 서울 강남구 아파트

tools.name: get_sold_cases
tools.description: Past sold court-auction cases similar to one item (same kind, appraisal within half to twice, nearest area first: same 동, 시·군·구, 시·도), with sale price, sale ÷ appraisal and failed rounds. Or give a place, kind and appraisal. Use this when: the person wants comparable sales before deciding a bid. 누구나 쓸 수 있습니다.

question.description: 물건 없이 찾을 때 지역·종류. 예: 수원시 영통구 아파트

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Send a short note (at most 1000 characters) about the service or one item to the operator. Use this when: the person reports a wrong value or a missing feature. 누구나 쓸 수 있습니다.
